subject: Progress bar does not show when i publish the app on shinyapps.io

messages.author: b5de47c8d9d3b216
messages.subject: Progress bar does not show when i publish the app on shinyapps.io
parts:
I have a shiny proj which has a progress bar in server.R. Everything works fine on my local box and i see the progress bar as well. But as soon as i publish the app to shinyapps , i don't see the progress bar at all although the code within the withProgressBar() function executes just fine


#ui.R
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Execute"),

  sidebarLayout( 
    sidebarPanel(
      textInput(label = "Input 1" , inputId="idInput1" ),    
      fileInput(label = "Input 2" , inputId="idInput2"),
      actionButton("button1" , "Execute This")),

    mainPanel(
      dataTableOutput("execute")
      , options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 5))
  )

))

#Server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  foo<- eventReactive(input$button1, 
   {
     i1 <- input$input1
     i2 <- input$input2$datapath
     withProgress(message = 'This will take time ',
                  detail = 'Please Wait...', value = 0, {
    #   some code here which takes a while to execute(uses i1 and i2)
 })
})
  
  output$execute <- renderDataTable({   
    foo()
    } )
})

messages.subject: Re: Progress bar does not show when i publish the app on shinyapps.io
parts:
this is the url :- https://predixion.shinyapps.io/shiny/   . Hit Execute and ideally you should see a progress bar and after a while you will see the message "Finished" in the main panel. On my local box , i see the progress bar but not on the shiny app

I slightly modified the server.r and ui.r files

#ui.r
library(shiny)
shinyUI(navbarPage(
  title = 'Test Shiny App',
  tabPanel('TestTab',
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
       textInput(label = "Input 1" , inputId="id1" , value="test" ),

       actionButton("buttonExecute" , "Execute")),
      mainPanel(textOutput('executeQuery'))
    ))
))

#server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  getResults<- eventReactive(input$buttonExecute , 
   {
     sn <- input$id1
     withProgress(message = 'Executing ',

for(i in 1:100000000)
          i
        
        "Finished"
    })
   })
  
  output$executeQuery <- renderText({  
    getResults() })
  
})
